lines: Seat 1 chooses Golemwright: at the end, 1 point per 3 Golems you have, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Wild tile at (1, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Warden: at the end, 1 point per tile from your opening you still hold, beyond the first, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Shifting tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Shifting tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Wild tile at (1, 0) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 3 wins the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 1) for 1 mana.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (0, -1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (2, -1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 3 wins the Steady tile at (0, -1) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Steady tile at (2, -1) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 2 gets the Shifting tile at (-1, -1) (yields 2) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 2 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 1 mana on the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 1).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 1 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 1 wins the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 2 wins the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 1) for 1 mana.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (0, 0) (yields 2) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Every trait stays secret until the end. Guess a rival's alongside your orders, once per rival.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 5 mana.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.
